command: set -euo pipefail; echo '===UNIT==='; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p Id -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p FragmentPath -p DropInPaths -p Result --no-pager; echo '===CAT==='; systemctl cat entityos-vm.service --no-pager || true; echo '===DROPINS==='; find /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d /usr/lib/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d /lib/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d -maxdepth 1 -type f -print -exec sha256sum {} \; 2>/dev/null || true; echo '===DBS==='; for p in /var/lib/entityos/data/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/var/lib/entityos/unified.db; do if [ -e "$p" ]; then stat -c '%n bytes=%s mtime=%y' "$p"; sha256sum "$p"; else echo MISSING "$p"; fi; done; echo '===WRITERS==='; ps -eo pid,ppid,user,cmd | grep -E '/opt/entityos/voice|entityos/rootfs-run' | grep -v grep || true; echo '===NO_LIFECYCLE_ACTION=1==='
